Arkansas Woodsmans Field Manual

Free guide — part of the Ozark Prepper library

The Arkansas woodsmans field manual is a guide to living in the Arkansas woods. It is about the woods, the weather, the tools, and the skills you need. It is written in plain English. It is a guide, not a promise of safety.

Safety first in the woods

The woods are beautiful. They are also dangerous. This chapter tells you what to respect.

  • Falling trees and branches
  • Sharp tools
  • Bad weather
  • No water or bad water
  • No way to get help
  • Bugs and snakes
  • Cold or heat
  • Getting lost

Things you need

Tell someone where you are going. Tell them when you will be back. Do not go alone. Do not go if you are not sure. Do not go without the right tools. Do not go in bad weather. Do not go if you are tired.

  • A phone, if the area has service
  • A map and compass
  • A first aid kit
  • More water than you think you need
  • Food
  • Warm clothes
  • A flashlight
  • A knife
  • A fire starter
  • A whistle
